provenance.note: The calibre must be one introduced for the rifle in a regular army, the police or customs and may not exceed 8 mm. D.7.17 (Teil D, PDF p. 34) allows the discipline with civil versions of service rifles that look like the original. The variant (mod.) has the distance, programme and face of this record and no record of its own.
